chunks: And from him, via the chain, from Ja'far, from his father, upon them be peace:
That Ali (peace be upon him) was brought a man who had married a woman while she was still married to her paternal aunt, so he flogged him and separated the two.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when a man marries a woman while she is married to her paternal aunt?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) application of the principle of *kafa’ah* or kinship prohibition, specifically ruling that marrying a woman while she is married to her paternal aunt (*khala*) constitutes a valid impediment. The dual penalty of flogging and separation underscores the juristic view that this specific kinship bond renders the marriage invalid or dissoluble, a stance that distinguishes Shia fiqh from some Sunni schools regarding the exact nature of the prohibition. It highlights the practical legal methodology of the Imams in resolving marital disputes based on clear textual and rational grounds.
